entries.en: Added `model` parameter to prompt-based stop hooks, allowing users to specify a custom model for hook evaluation
entries.zh: 为基于提示的停止挂钩添加了`model`参数，允许用户指定用于挂钩评估的自定义模型

entries.en: SDK: Support custom timeouts for hooks
entries.zh: SDK：支持为钩子设置自定义超时

entries.en: Plugins: Added support for sharing and installing output styles
entries.zh: 插件：支持分享和安装输出样式

entries.en: Allow more safe git commands to run without approval
entries.zh: 允许更安全的 git 命令在未经批准的情况下运行

entries.en: Teleporting a session from web will automatically set the upstream branch
entries.zh: 从网页端传送会话时，会自动设置上游分支

entries.en: Fixed slash commands from user settings being loaded twice, which could cause rendering issues
entries.zh: 修复了用户设置中的斜杠命令被加载两次，这可能会导致渲染问题

entries.en: Fixed incorrect labeling of user settings vs project settings in command descriptions
entries.zh: 修复了命令描述中用户设置与项目设置的错误标签

entries.en: Fixed crash when plugin command hooks timeout during execution
entries.zh: 修复了插件命令在执行过程中挂钩超时时发生的崩溃

entries.en: Fixed: Bedrock users no longer see duplicate Opus entries in the /model picker when using `--model haiku`
entries.zh: 修复：使用 `--model haiku` 时，Bedrock 用户在 /model 选择器中不再看到重复的 Opus 条目

entries.en: Fixed broken security documentation links in trust dialogs and onboarding
entries.zh: 修复了信任对话框和入门中损坏的安全文档链接

entries.en: Fixed issue where pressing ESC to close the diff modal would also interrupt the model
entries.zh: 修复了按 ESC 关闭 diff 模式也会中断模型的问题

entries.en: ctrl-r history search landing on a slash command no longer cancels the search
entries.zh: ctrl-r 历史搜索跳到斜杠命令时，不再取消搜索
